USE EPA
SET NOCOUNT ON 
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..##FEP', 'U') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##FEP
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..##FEPCL', 'U') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##FEPCL
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..##FEPDUPS', 'U') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##FEPDUPS
GO

Select charSeparator = cast((select VALUE From [EPA].EPA_SETTING Where Name = 'FEP_Automation:charSeparator'And Active = 1) as varchar(255)),
isDebug = cast((select VALUE From [EPA].EPA_SETTING Where Name = 'FEP_Automation:isDebug' And Active = 1) as bit),
debugEmail = cast((select VALUE From [EPA].EPA_SETTING Where Name = 'FEP_Automation:debugEmail' And Active = 1) as varchar(255))

CREATE TABLE ##FEP (
[Revenue Code] [varchar](4) NULL,
[Claim Source] [varchar](255) NULL,
[Claim ID] [varchar](255) NULL,
[Provider ID] [varchar](255)NULL,
[Provider Name][varchar](255)NULL,
[Fin Arg] [varchar](255)NULL,
[MBU] [varchar](255)NULL,
[Funding CF code] [varchar](255)NULL,
[Provider Control Number][varchar](255)NULL,
[Service Start Date] datetime NULL,
[Service End Date] datetime NULL,
[Paid Date] datetime NULL,
[Group ID] [varchar](255) NULL,
[Group Name][varchar](255) NULL,
[Healthcard ID][varchar](255) NULL,
[Last Name][varchar](255) NULL,
[First Name][varchar](255) NULL,
[DOB] [varchar] (255) NULL,
[Sex][varchar](255)NULL,
[Dx 1][varchar](255)NULL,
[Dx 2][varchar](255)NULL,
[Provider Tax ID][varchar](255)NULL,
[Provider NPI][varchar](255)NULL,
[Provider City][varchar](255)NULL,
[Provider State][varchar](255)NULL,
[X ref claim ID][varchar](255)NULL,
[OP Claim ID][varchar](255)NULL,
[Billed Amount][numeric](18, 4)NULL,
[Non Covered Amount][numeric](18, 4)NULL,
[(allowed) Disc Covered Amount][numeric](18, 4)NULL,
[Deduct Amount][numeric](18, 4)NULL,
[Coins Amount][numeric](18, 4)NULL,
[CoPay Amount][numeric](18, 4)NULL,
[Paid Amount][numeric](18, 4)NULL,
[Refund To Anthem][numeric](18, 4) NULL,
Notes [varchar] (5000) NULL,
RecoveryCode [varchar](255) NULL,
RecoveryType [varchar](255) NULL,
--End of Template
[qaLineLevel] [varchar](1) NULL,
[QA_CHECK] [varchar](100) NULL,
ROWID [int] NULL,
--Readmissions
[WHICH_CLM_RECOV][varchar](255)NULL,
[ClaimFlip] [varchar](1) NULL,
[EPA_CLM_ID] [varchar](20) NULL)
GO

--Insert Implants
INSERT INTO ##FEP
SELECT
'UNK' AS [Revenue Code]
,'FEP'AS [Claim Source]
,CLAIM.[CLM_NBR] AS [Claim ID]
,RIGHT(CLAIM.serv_prov_id,6) AS [Provider ID]
,CLAIM.prov_name AS [Provider Name]
,CLAIM.funding AS [Fin Arg]
,CLAIM.MBU_CF_CD AS MBU
,CLAIM.FUNDG_CF_CD AS [Funding CF code]
,'UNK' AS [Provider Control Number]
,LINES.CLM_LINE_SRVC_STRT_DT AS [Service Start Date]
,LINES.CLM_LINE_SRVC_END_DT AS [Service End Date]
,CLAIM.ADJDCTN_DT AS [Paid Date]
,CLAIM.EMPLOYER_GROUP_NBR AS [Group ID]
,CLAIM.EMPLOYER_GROUP_NAME AS [Group Name]
,CLAIM.[SRC_SBSCRBR_ID] AS [Healthcard ID]
,CLAIM.SRC_MBR_LAST_NM AS [Last Name]
,CLAIM.SRC_MBR_FRST_NM AS [First Name]
,CLAIM.SRC_MBR_BRTH_DT AS [DOB]
,'UNK' AS [Sex]
,CLAIM.diag1_cd AS [Dx 1]
,CLAIM.diag2_cd AS [Dx 2]
,CLAIM.SRC_BILLG_TAX_ID AS [Provider Tax ID]
,CLAIM.SRC_PROV_NATL_PROV_ID AS [Provider NPI]
,'' AS [Provider City]
,'' AS [Provider State]
,'' AS [X ref claim ID]
,'' AS [OP Claim ID]
,LINES.[BILLD_CHRG_AMT] AS [Billed Amount]
,0 AS [Non Covered Amount]
,0 AS [(allowed) Disc Covered Amount]
,0 AS [Deduct Amount]
,0 AS [Coins Amount]
,0 AS [CoPay Amount]
,LINES.PAID_AMT AS [Paid Amount]
,[AUDIT].REF_AMOUNT AS [Refund To Anthem]
,[AUDIT].[PA_COMMENTS] AS Notes
,'218B' AS RecoveryCode
,'Provider Audit Supplies Billed as Implants' AS RecoveryType
,'N' AS [qaLineLevel]
,NULL AS [QA_CHECK]
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CLAIM.[CLM_NBR] DESC) AS ROWID
,NULL
,'N'
,CLAIM.[EPA_CLM_ID]
FROM EPA.EPA_CLAIM_IMPLANT AS CLAIM

INNER JOIN EPA.EPA_CLAIM_IMPLANT_LINES AS LINES
	ON
	CLAIM.CLM_ADJSTMNT_KEY=LINES.CLM_ADJSTMNT_KEY
	AND
	CLAIM.CLM_NBR=LINES.CLM_NBR

INNER JOIN EPA.EPA_CLAIM_IMPLANT_AUDIT AS [AUDIT]
	ON 
	LINES.CLM_NBR=[AUDIT].CLM_NBR
	AND
	LINES.CLM_LINE_NBR=[AUDIT].[CLM_LINE_NBR]
	

WHERE STATUS_ID = 4 
AND [AUDIT].STATUS_REASON_ID = 12 --completed
AND REF_AMOUNT > .01
AND IS_RECOVERABLE=1
AND ISNUMERIC(CLAIM.CLM_ITS_SCCF_NBR)=0
AND LEFT(CLAIM.MBU_CF_CD,2)='FE'

,'UNK' AS [Dx 2]

,CLAIM.PROV_STATE AS [Provider State]

,'' AS [OP Claim ID]
,LINES.[BILLD_CHRG_AMT] AS [Billed Amount]
,0 AS [Non Covered Amount]
,0 AS [(allowed) Disc Covered Amount]
,0 AS [Deduct Amount]
,0 AS [Coins Amount]
,0 AS [CoPay Amount]
,LINES.PAID_AMT AS [Paid Amount]
,LINES.PAID_AMT AS [Refund To Anthem]
,[AUDIT].[RATIONALE] AS Notes
,'76' AS RecoveryCode
,'Provider Audit Coding' AS RecoveryType
,'N' AS [qaLineLevel]
,NULL AS [QA_CHECK]
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CLAIM.[CLM_NBR] DESC) AS ROWID
,NULL
,'N'
,CLAIM.[EPA_CLM_ID]

FROM EPA.EPA_CODING_CLAIM AS CLAIM

INNER JOIN EPA.EPA_CODING_CLAIM_LINES AS LINES
	ON
	CLAIM.CLM_ADJSTMNT_KEY=LINES.CLM_ADJSTMNT_KEY
	AND
	CLAIM.CLM_NBR=LINES.CLM_NBR

INNER JOIN EPA.EPA_CODING_CLAIM_AUDIT AS [AUDIT]
	ON 
	LINES.CLM_NBR=[AUDIT].CLM_NBR
	AND
	LINES.CLM_LINE_NBR=[AUDIT].[CLM_LINE_NBR]
	

WHERE 

--Completed Reviews for CS90 NON ITS Population
[AUDIT].DETERMINATION_CODE=2 --denied
AND [AUDIT].STATUS_REASON_ID = 12 --completed
AND LINES.PAID_AMT>0
AND ISNUMERIC(CLAIM.CLM_ITS_SCCF_NBR)=0
AND LEFT(CLAIM.MBU_CF_CD,2)='FE'

--DRG Validation
INSERT INTO ##FEP
SELECT
'UNK' AS [Revenue Code]
,'FEP'AS [Claim Source]
,CLAIM.[CLM_NBR] AS [Claim ID]
,RIGHT(CLAIM.PROV_ID,6) AS [Provider ID]
,[PROV_NM] AS [Provider Name]
,CLAIM.[PROD_LVL_3_DESC] AS [Fin Arg]
,CLAIM.MBU_CF_CD AS MBU
,CLAIM.FUNDG_CF_CD AS [Funding CF code]
,'UNK' AS [Provider Control Number]
,CLAIM.ADMT_DT AS [Service Start Date]
,CLAIM.DSCHRG_DT AS [Service End Date]
,CLAIM.ADJDCTN_DT AS [Paid Date]
,'UNK' AS [Group ID]
,'UNK' AS [Group Name]
,CLAIM.[SBSCRBR_ID] AS [Healthcard ID]
,CLAIM.[MBR_LAST_NAME] AS [Last Name]
,CLAIM.[MBR_FIRST_NAME] AS [First Name]
,CLAIM.[DOB] AS [DOB]
,CLAIM.[GENDER] AS [Sex]
,CLAIM.DIAG_CD_1 AS [Dx 1]
,CLAIM.DIAG_CD_1 AS [Dx 2]
,CLAIM.PROV_TIN AS [Provider Tax ID]
,CLAIM.PROV_NPI AS [Provider NPI]
,'' AS [Provider City]
,'' AS [Provider State]
,'' AS [X ref claim ID]
,'' AS [OP Claim ID]
,CLAIM.[BILLD_CHRG_AMT] AS [Billed Amount]
,0 AS [Non Covered Amount]
,0 AS [(allowed) Disc Covered Amount]
,0 AS [Deduct Amount]
,0 AS [Coins Amount]
,0 AS [CoPay Amount]
,CLAIM.PAID_AMT AS [Paid Amount]
,[AUDIT].EST_OVERPAYMENT AS [Refund To Anthem]
,[AUDIT].[PA_COMMENTS] AS Notes
,'65' AS RecoveryCode
,'Provider Audit Validation' AS RecoveryType
,'N' AS [qaLineLevel]
,NULL AS [QA_CHECK]
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CLAIM.[CLM_NBR] DESC) AS ROWID
,NULL
,'N'
,CLAIM.[EPA_CLM_ID]
FROM [EPA].[EPA_CLAIM_DRG_VALIDATION] AS CLAIM

INNER JOIN [EPA].[EPA_CLAIM_DRG_VALIDATION_AUDIT] AS [AUDIT]
   ON CLAIM.[EPA_CLM_ID]=[AUDIT].[EPA_CLM_ID]

WHERE
STATUS_ID = 4 --Completed
AND STATUS_REASON_ID =12--Review Completed
AND EST_OVERPAYMENT > 0
AND IS_RECOVERABLE=1
AND CLM_ITS_SCCF_NBR IS NULL
AND LEFT(MBU_CF_CD,2)='FE'

ORDER BY [Paid Date]

--Readmissions
INSERT INTO ##FEP
SELECT 
'UNK' AS [Revenue Code]
,CLAIM.CLAIMS_SYSTEM_NAME AS [Claim Source]
,RECOV_CLM_NBR AS [Claim ID]
,RIGHT(CLAIM.RECOV_PROV_ID,6) AS [Provider ID]
,CLAIM.RECOV_PROV_NAME AS [Provider Name]
,RECOV_FUNDING AS [Fin Arg]
,RECOV_MBU_CF_CD AS [MBU]
,RECOV_FUNDG_CF_CD AS [Funding CF code]
,'UNK' AS [Provider Control Number]
,CONVERT(DATETIME,RECOV_CLM_STMNT_FROM_DT,101)AS [Service Start Date]
,CONVERT(DATETIME,RECOV_CLM_STMNT_TO_DT ,101) AS [Service End Date]
,CONVERT(DATETIME,RECOV_PAID_DT,101) AS [Paid Date]
,RECOV_GRP_NBR AS [Group ID]
,'UNK' AS [Group Name]
,RECOV_SBSCRBR_ID AS [Healthcard ID]
,SRC_MBR_LAST_NM AS [Last Name]
,SRC_MBR_FRST_NM AS [First Name]
,'UNK' AS [DOB]
,'UNK' AS [Sex]
,CLAIM.RECOV_DIAG1_CD AS [Dx 1]
,CLAIM.RECOV_DIAG2_CD AS [Dx 2]
,CLAIM.RECOV_TAX_ID AS [Provider Tax ID]
,CLAIM.RECOV_NPI AS [Provider NPI]
,'UNK' AS [Provider City]
,CLAIM.MARKET_ID AS [Provider State]
,XREF_CLM_NBR AS [X ref claim ID]
,'' AS [OP Claim ID]
,RECOV_BILLD_CHRG_TOT AS [Billed Amount]
,0.00 AS [Non Covered Amount]
,RECOV_ALWD_TOT AS [(allowed) Disc Covered Amount]
,RECOV_DDCTBL_TOT AS [Deduct Amount]
,RECOV_COINSRN_TOT AS [Coins Amount]
,RECOV_CPAY_TOT AS [CoPay Amount]
,RECOV_PAID_TOT AS [Paid Amount]
,[AUDIT].EST_OVERPAYMENT AS [Refund To Anthem]
--Tab char(9) ,Line feed char(10),Carriage return (13)
,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE([AUDIT].PA_NOTES, CHAR(9), ''), CHAR(10), ''), CHAR(13), ''))) AS [Notes]
,'64' AS RecoveryCode
,'Provider Audit DRG' AS RecoveryType
,'N' AS [qaLineLevel]
,NULL AS [QA_CHECK]
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CLAIM.RECOV_CLM_NBR DESC) AS ROWID

--Readmission Flip
,[WHICH_CLM_RECOV]
,'N' --ClaimFlip
,[AUDIT].EPA_CLM_ID
FROM EPA.EPA_CLAIM_AUDIT AS [AUDIT]

INNER JOIN EPA.EPA_CLAIM AS CLAIM ON
AUDIT.EPA_CLM_ID = CLAIM.EPA_CLM_ID

LEFT JOIN EPA.EPA_USER AS [USER] ON
AUDIT.[AUDITOR]=[USER_ACCOUNT]

WHERE STATUS_ID = 4 --Completed
AND STATUS_REASON_ID =12--Review Completed
AND EST_OVERPAYMENT > 0
AND IS_RECOVERABLE=1
AND RECOV_CLM_ITS_SCCF_NBR='UNK'
AND LEFT(RECOV_MBU_CF_CD,2)='FE'

--Multiple Line Recoveries
UPDATE ##FEP
SET [qaLineLevel]='Y'
WHERE [Claim ID] in 
(SELECT [Claim ID]
FROM  ##FEP
GROUP BY [Claim ID]
HAVING COUNT(*) >1)

---Flip What we want to recover on for readmissions...pass XREF data to VRDB instead of RECOV
UPDATE ##FEP
SET
[Claim ID]=XREF_CLM_NBR
,[Provider ID]=RIGHT(CLAIM.XREF_PROV_ID,6)
,[Provider Name]=CLAIM.XREF_PROV_NAME
,[Service Start Date]=XREF_CLM_STMNT_FROM_DT
,[Service End Date]=XREF_CLM_STMNT_TO_DT
,[Paid Date]=XREF_PAID_DT
,[Group ID]=XREF_GRP_NBR
,[Dx 1]=CLAIM.XREF_DIAG1_CD
,[Dx 2]=CLAIM.XREF_DIAG2_CD
,[X ref claim ID]=RECOV_CLM_NBR
,[Billed Amount]=XREF_BILLD_CHRG_TOT
,[(allowed) Disc Covered Amount]=XREF_ALWD_TOT
,[Deduct Amount]=XREF_DDCTBL_TOT 
,[Coins Amount]=XREF_COINSRN_TOT 
,[CoPay Amount]=XREF_CPAY_TOT
,[Paid Amount]=XREF_PAID_TOT
,ClaimFlip='Y'

FROM ##FEP AS CS90

INNER JOIN EPA.EPA_CLAIM_AUDIT AS AUDIT
ON CS90.EPA_CLM_ID=AUDIT.EPA_CLM_ID
AND CS90.EPA_CLM_ID<>AUDIT.WHICH_CLM_RECOV

INNER JOIN EPA.EPA_CLAIM AS CLAIM ON
AUDIT.EPA_CLM_ID = CLAIM.EPA_CLM_ID

GO
